status: design calculation, not an implemented spawn system
assumptions: Each appearance has an independent 10% gold roll.
The observer sees every counted appearance.
A gold appearance is not the same as a successful tame.
Travel, competition, eligibility and server-instance policy are excluded.
clock_time_note: Multiplying a count by 30 minutes assumes waiting a full interval before every opportunity; arrival phase and missed appearances change elapsed waiting time. No time-to-tame guarantee follows.
